name: Analog Way AWJ (LivePremier/Aquilon, Midra, Alta 4K)
notes: Recommended module for Aquilon (the older analogway-livepremier module is REST fire-and-forget and marked as legacy). The module picks the platform at connect time: device name prefix NLC = Aquilon, firmware major >= 4 uses the livepremier4 code path, otherwise livepremier (src/connection.ts:141-153).

All screen, layer, memory and source choices come from the connected device or the LivePremier simulator; without a connection the module offers only emulated entries. Screen ids are device keys such as S1 and A1.

Option sets were taken from the generic definitions in src/awjdevice/actions.ts and, where Aquilon overrides them, from src/livepremier/actions.ts (select source, test patterns, audio routing, GPO). Aquilon firmware >= 4 (src/livepremier4/actions.ts) changes audio routing (one pair of choice lists per linked device), the GPO range and keying/select-layer details, which are not modelled here.
Several actions generate extra option ids per screen at runtime (for example layerS1); these entries are marked optionsComplete=false.
Built on @companion-module/base 1.x (~1.9.0): no expressions; variables only in textinputs with useVariables.
